aspects.description: Every page passes the W3C HTML validator with no errors
aspects.extraDescription: Deduct 0.5 for each page reporting one or more errors, to a minimum of 0

aspects.description: Landmark elements (header, nav, main, footer) are used on every page
All informative images carry a meaningful alt attribute
aspects.extraDescription: Deduct 0.25 per image missing or with an empty alt where content is conveyed

aspects.description: Keyboard navigation across the whole site
aspects.extraDescription: Judge with the mouse unplugged: tab order, visible focus, no traps
descriptors: The site cannot be operated by keyboard alone; focus is lost or trapped
Most controls are reachable but focus is invisible or the order is erratic
All controls are reachable in a sensible order with visible focus; minor lapses
Every control is reachable in document order with clear focus and no traps

aspects.description: Quality of the layout across breakpoints
descriptors: The layout breaks: content overlaps, is clipped, or is unreadable
The layout holds together but is cramped or awkward at some widths
The layout adapts well at every width, with consistent spacing
The layout is deliberate at every width; the design clearly anticipated each one

aspects.description: Typography, colour and spacing against the supplied brand sheet
descriptors: The brand sheet appears to have been ignored
Some brand elements are present, applied inconsistently
The brand is applied consistently with occasional deviation
The brand is applied faithfully throughout, including states and edge cases
